# kilo-mcp-conflict-resolver

Use this skill to resolve merge conflicts in files generated by parallel
Kilo tasks.

## Logic and Behavior

- **Context:** You have been invoked by the Architect to resolve merge conflicts (`<<<<<<< HEAD`).
- **Action:** Find every file with conflict markers in the current working directory. Analyze both versions of the code logically.
- **Resolution:** Edit the files removing the markers and integrating the code so that the semantics of both parallel features are preserved.
- **Verification:** Run the linter and/or a basic build to confirm the resolution did not break the syntax.
